blocks.title: LSPD - 1-HOUR 30-MINUTE MANDATORY ACADEMY TRAINING CHECKLIST
blocks.subtitle: Streamlined Single-Session Academy: Covers CAD, Traffic Stops, Code 5, Investigation, Medical, and SOPs.

blocks.text:
Fingerprint all Trainee and Check profile record.
  - if felon, do not continue training. Mark on drop down and submit this form
Rule #1 (Embrace Live Chaos): Active server calls take priority. Use them as live teaching moments. Do not penalize for server unpredictability.
Rule #2 (Keep Moving): Except during Module 1, never stay parked for more than 3 minutes. Teach while on patrol.
Rule #3 (Action Required): Need at least 1 arrest and 1 citation.

blocks.title: MODULE 1: SOP, USE OF FORCE & CASE LAW (20 MIN)

items.standard: Covers Integrity, Respect, Selfless Service, and proper reporting hierarchy.
Governed by Reasonableness, Necessity, Proportionality. Covers 5 Tiers: Presence, Verbalization, Empty-Hand, Less-Lethal (Taser/Beanbag), and Lethal Force (IMMEDIATE THREAT).
This city we enforce California Law - if it's a law in California we must follow as well.

Brief review of Terry v. Ohio (Stop & Frisk), Carroll v. Ohio (Auto Exception), Mapp v. Ohio (Exclusionary Rule), and Tennessee v. Garner (IMMEDIATE THREAT standard). Refer to DOC file for further explanation.
Mandatory on-duty bodycam usage (/bodycam) or mandatory 3rd-party recording software (strictly required for OIS).

blocks.title: MODULE 2: CAD, RADIO & TRAFFIC STOPS (25 MIN)

items.standard: Navigating CAD tabs, running profiles, vehicles, and weapon serial numbers; filing Reports vs. Cases.
Cover where it's located at, how to use it, and where to copy and paste the report
RTO discipline, callsign formatting, 10-41/10-8, and military phonetics for plate checks.
Cruiser positioning (1.5-2 car lengths, 40° offset for Officer's Alleyway), safe B-post approach, Teach and avoid the Deadly Zone, and Wraith ARS 2X radar operation.
Drafting and issuing citations using /citation, inventory physical handoff, unpaid fine rules (5-day doubling under Postal 388), and tag DMV registration Postal 697, 745, or 040.

blocks.title: MODULE 3: INVESTIGATION, ARREST WORKFLOW & MEDICAL (30 MIN)

items.standard: Using flashlights/cameras for evidence (Casing, Blood, Vehicle fragments), talk about how to do vehicle fingerprint sweeps, and serial number checks.
Teach correctly seizing weapons tied to felonies vs. returning Civ firearms under the 5-day felon rules. If the weapon is illegal, always seized.
Lawful detention, probable cause, searching, cuffing, transport, booking photo, CAD Case creation, automated fees/sentences (max limits: 55 mos / $60,000 fine), state jail transfer.
Talk about when you are required to read the suspect their Miranda Rights. Talk about the LSPD Standard for report writing.
Teach how to use the medical menu. Always check for SAFR on channel 9.

blocks.title: MODULE 4: TACTICAL CODE 5 & FINAL CATCH-UP (15 MIN)

items.standard: Finish covering any material not yet reviewed. Find a quiet place and complete all unchecked requirements.
Three-car felony stop formation, officer roles (C1-C4), verbal commands, and suspect prone positioning.
10-80 / 10-70 callouts, primary/secondary radio handoffs, P.I.T. requests, and cone/flare taper layouts.
